info.name: Zencargo GraphQL API
info.description: Zencargo digital freight forwarding & supply-chain GraphQL API. All operations are POST requests to a single per-tenant endpoint: https://{{accountReference}}.api.{{environment}}.zencargo.com/graphql. Authentication is HTTP Basic using an API Key ID (UUID) as the username and its secret as the password. Set {{basicAuthBase64}} to base64(keyId:secret) or use Postman's Basic Auth with the ID/secret. Queries and mutations below are grounded in the public docs at https://api-docs.zencargo.com; some payloads are illustrative. Realtime updates are delivered via outbound HTTP webhooks, not WebSocket.

request.description: Fetch a booking and its attached documents (assetUrl is the download link).
Retrieve mode of transport, load type, incoterms, and the consignor/consignee/forwarder for a booking.

item.name: Query scheduled legs and voyage milestone

request.description: Track shipment progress: scheduled carriage legs with ETD/ETA/ATD/ATA plus the current voyage milestone.
Estimated vs. actual collection and delivery per cargo.
Create a purchase order with ordered line items (PurchaseOrdersCreateOrder mutation).
Retrieve a purchase order with its line items and SKU-level Lots.
List products and their SKU codes (the documented 'first call' example).
Find the first two products whose name contains 'chair'.

item.name: Query packing lists for a booking

request.description: Query packing lists for a booking (BOOKING_REFERENCE) or a cargo (CARGO_ID).
Retrieve an account by UUID with a nested products connection.
Search assignable accounts (e.g. suppliers) to resolve origin/destination/manufacturer IDs.
